# 自動餘裕 Preamp -4.7 dB：確保（甜度/溫暖/空氣感）推上去後不削波
Preamp: -4.7 dB

# 拆成 MID（正中＝女聲）／SIDE（兩側＝伴奏）

Channel: L
Filter 1: ON HPQ Fc 35 Hz Q 0.7
Filter 2: ON LS Fc 150 Hz Gain 1.0 dB Q 0.7
Filter 3: ON PK Fc 350 Hz Gain -2.0 dB Q 1.4
Filter 4: ON PK Fc 3000 Hz Gain 1.0 dB Q 0.9
Filter 5: ON PK Fc 7500 Hz Gain -0.8 dB Q 2.0
Filter 6: ON HS Fc 10000 Hz Gain 1.0 dB

# 實測：推力 0 dB→THD 0.32%／推力 12 dB→THD 5.17%，兩者都是偶次諧波為主
Preamp: +6.0 dB
VSTPlugin: Library "E:\AI\workspace\vocal_focus\vst\airwindows\WinVST64s\PurestWarm64.dll"
Preamp: -6.0 dB

# SIDE：伴奏
Channel: R
Preamp: -4.0 dB
Filter 1: ON PK Fc 2000 Hz Gain -1.5 dB Q 0.8

# 還原回 L/R
Channel: all
Copy: L=L+R
Copy: R=L+-2.0*R
